rulings.rationale: Factually incorrect. The main repo's nitrogen_cycle.rs is 1024 lines with complete denitrification implementation (Monod kinetics, suboxic pore water mixing, NO3/DOC limitation, alkalinity production — lines 510-585), while the worktree's version is only 644 lines with zero denitrification references. The main repo is 111 commits ahead of the worktree (461 vs 350). The worktree (.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7) is a stale snapshot from an earlier development stage, NOT the source of truth. The amendment's claim that 'none of the tank_core implementation or tests would ship' is wrong — the code IS in the main repo tree and WILL ship normally. Reviewer 1's detailed evidence (1024 vs 644 lines, main repo ahead) is confirmed by direct file inspection and git history.
